name: Enrich Person Profile
description: Fills the profile of every person in a People view who lacks it (Headline, About, Role Description, Role Start Date, Person City, Person Country, Education, Skills, Languages, Prior Employer, Prior Title; created on first use): GetLeads first, one lookup per person by email, LinkedIn URL or name at the domain, on fair-use rows; Blitz by email for the ones GetLeads misses, one credit each, only up to Max Rows. Blanks filled on the held row, nothing overwritten, no new rows.
